info.name: CampusConnect Event API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the CampusConnect Event Management REST API (Spring Boot 3 · Java 17 · H2). Covers all CRUD endpoints with valid and invalid examples for every operation.

Base URL: http://localhost:8080
API prefix: /api/events

Run the Spring Boot app first:
  cd event_api && mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run

variable.description: Update this after creating or fetching an event

request.description:
Retrieves the full list of CampusConnect events from the H2 in-memory database.

Expected: 200 OK with a JSON array of 5 pre-loaded sample events.

item.name: GET /api/events/{id} — Retrieve Event by ID (200 OK)

request.description:
Retrieves a single event by its numeric ID.

Expected: 200 OK with the matching event JSON object.
Set the `event_id` collection variable to a valid ID (e.g., 1).

item.name: GET /api/events/9999 — Event Not Found (404 Not Found)

request.description:
Attempts to retrieve an event with a non-existent ID.

Expected: 404 Not Found with JSON error body:
{
  "timestamp": "...",
  "status": 404,
  "error": "Not Found",
  "message": "Event with ID 9999 not found",
  "path": "/api/events/9999"
}

item.name: GET /api/events/abc — Invalid ID Type (400 Bad Request)

request.description:
Attempts to fetch an event with a non-numeric path variable.

Expected: 400 Bad Request — type mismatch error (Long required, String given).

body.raw:
{
  "title": "AI & Robotics Symposium 2026",
  "category": "Technical",
  "date": "2026-11-20",
  "time": "11:00 AM",
  "venue": "Robotics Arena, Hall 3",
  "organizer": "Robotics Society",
  "capacity": 80,
  "registeredCount": 25,
  "description": "Showcase of autonomous robotics and ML projects by campus student teams competing for inter-university awards."
}

request.description:
Creates a new CampusConnect event. All fields are required.

Expected: 201 Created with the newly created event (including auto-generated `id`).
Save the returned `id` into the `event_id` variable for subsequent requests.

item.name: POST /api/events — Create Fully Booked Event (201 Created)

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Full Capacity Photography Workshop",
  "category": "Workshop",
  "date": "2026-12-01",
  "time": "03:00 PM",
  "venue": "Media Lab, Block A",
  "organizer": "Photography Club",
  "capacity": 30,
  "registeredCount": 30,
  "description": "Hands-on DSLR and mobile photography basics for campus students."
}

request.description:
Creates an event where registeredCount equals capacity (fully booked at creation).

Expected: 201 Created — this is valid since registeredCount == capacity (not exceeding it).
This event will return 409 Conflict when /register is called.

item.name: POST /api/events — Missing Required Fields (400 Bad Request)

request.description:
Sends blank title and venue — fails Jakarta Bean Validation.

Expected: 400 Bad Request with `validationErrors` map showing which fields failed and why.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Zero Capacity Event",
  "category": "Technical",
  "date": "2026-11-25",
  "time": "10:00 AM",
  "venue": "Lab 1",
  "organizer": "Tech Club",
  "capacity": 0,
  "registeredCount": 0,
  "description": "Capacity cannot be zero or negative."
}

request.description:
Sends capacity = 0 — violates @Min(1) constraint.

Expected: 400 Bad Request with validationErrors.capacity = 'Capacity must be greater than zero'.

item.name: POST /api/events — registeredCount Exceeds Capacity (400 Bad Request)

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Overflow Registration Event",
  "category": "Technical",
  "date": "2026-11-25",
  "time": "10:00 AM",
  "venue": "Lab 1",
  "organizer": "Tech Club",
  "capacity": 50,
  "registeredCount": 65,
  "description": "This should fail because 65 > 50."
}

request.description:
Sends registeredCount (65) > capacity (50) — service-level validation.

Expected: 400 Bad Request with message: 'Registered count (65) cannot exceed total capacity (50)'.

Sends empty JSON object — all @NotBlank / @NotNull constraints fire.

Expected: 400 Bad Request with validationErrors listing all 9 required fields.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "National Campus Hackathon 2026 — Extended Edition",
  "category": "Hackathon",
  "date": "2026-10-16",
  "time": "09:30 AM",
  "venue": "Innovation & Tech Lab, Block C & D",
  "organizer": "ACM Student Chapter & GDSC",
  "capacity": 150,
  "registeredCount": 110,
  "description": "Extended 48-hour hackathon focused on full-stack web applications, AI automation, and cloud microservices. Open to all branches."
}

request.description:
Fully replaces all fields of an existing event. Every field must be provided.

Expected: 200 OK with the completely updated event object.

item.name: PUT /api/events/9999 — Update Non-existent Event (404 Not Found)

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Ghost Event",
  "category": "General",
  "date": "2026-12-01",
  "time": "10:00 AM",
  "venue": "Nowhere Hall",
  "organizer": "No One",
  "capacity": 100,
  "registeredCount": 0,
  "description": "This event does not exist."
}

request.description:
Tries to update an event ID that doesn't exist.

Expected: 404 Not Found — 'Event with ID 9999 not found'.

item.name: PUT /api/events/{id} — registeredCount Exceeds Capacity (400 Bad Request)

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Bad Update Event",
  "category": "Technical",
  "date": "2026-11-30",
  "time": "09:00 AM",
  "venue": "Lab 2",
  "organizer": "Dev Club",
  "capacity": 40,
  "registeredCount": 55,
  "description": "registeredCount exceeds capacity — should be rejected."
}

request.description:
Full update with registeredCount (55) > capacity (40).

Expected: 400 Bad Request — service validates capacity rules on PUT as well.

Partially updates only the `category` and `date` fields. All other fields remain unchanged.

Expected: 200 OK with updated category and date in the response.

Partially updates capacity and registeredCount. Cross-field validation still applies.

Expected: 200 OK with the new capacity (200) and registeredCount (115).

Updates all four patchable fields simultaneously: category, date, capacity, and registeredCount.

Expected: 200 OK.

Tries to patch category with a whitespace-only string.

Expected: 400 Bad Request — 'Category cannot be blank when updating'.

item.name: PATCH /api/events/{id} — Capacity Below Registered (400 Bad Request)

request.description:
Reduces capacity to 10 when registeredCount is already higher (e.g., 95 for the Hackathon).

Expected: 400 Bad Request — 'Registered count (X) cannot exceed total capacity (10)'.

item.name: PATCH /api/events/9999 — Patch Non-existent Event (404 Not Found)

request.description:
Attempts a PATCH on an ID that does not exist.

Expected: 404 Not Found.

Deletes the event with the specified ID.

Expected: 204 No Content — no response body.
After this, a GET on the same ID should return 404.

item.name: DELETE /api/events/9999 — Delete Non-existent Event (404 Not Found)

request.description:
Tries to delete an event that doesn't exist.

Expected: 404 Not Found — safe idempotent behavior (explicit error rather than silent ignore).

Increments `registeredCount` by 1 if the event has available capacity.

Expected: 200 OK with the updated event showing registeredCount + 1.
Call this multiple times to watch the count increase toward capacity.

Event ID 4 is the Workshop (capacity 60, registeredCount 60 — full at startup).

Expected: 409 Conflict with message:
'Cannot register for event ... capacity is full (60/60 registered)'

Note: If IDs shifted, first run GET /api/events to find the full Workshop event.

item.name: POST /api/events/9999/register — Register to Non-existent Event (404 Not Found)

request.description:
Tries to register for an event that doesn't exist.

Expected: 404 Not Found — 'Event with ID 9999 not found'.

item.name: GET H2 Console — Open in Browser (not Postman)

request.description:
Open this URL in a web browser (not Postman) to access the H2 web console.

Login credentials:
  JDBC URL:  jdbc:h2:mem:campusconnect_db
  Username:  sa
  Password:  (leave empty)

You can run SQL queries like:
  SELECT * FROM EVENTS;
  SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EVENTS;
